const.justification: No decision carry-forward or implicit fallback.

execution_timeframe.justification: Fixed 5m execution with no selector descent.

mandatory_confirmations.justification: The 1m confirmation is mandatory and cannot be substituted.

entry_zone.justification: Versioned symmetric VWAP/ATR scalping Shadow zone.

stop.justification: Single ATR stop source without pivot fallback.

targets.justification: One target at exactly 1.8 gross R.

minimum_net_r.justification: Every target must retain this R after all venue costs.

invalidation.justification: The stop is the sole price invalidation boundary.

time_stop.justification: Two-hour maximum duration, additionally bounded by the UTC day boundary.

cost_contract.justification: Fees are exchange-owned; spread, slippage and funding require exact sources.

order_policy.justification: Limit-only Shadow policy with fixed expiry and live-cost guards.
